versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Improved authentication instructions: Now includes a check for an existing Hugging Face token before prompting user setup.
- Updated authentication section: Provides clear fallback steps if no token is found, helping users set up credentials more easily.
- All other content and functionality remain unchanged.

- Improved authentication instructions: now includes a token check command and explicit guidance on what to do if no token is found.
- Reorganized authentication section for clarity.
- No functional changes to code examples or feature usage.

Initial release – Generate multimedia content via HuggingFace Spaces and Inference Providers.

- Supports image, video, audio, and text generation directly using HuggingFace Spaces.
- Enables batch generation and chaining of multiple Spaces for advanced workflows.
- Guides on using `gradio_client` and `huggingface_hub` for programmatic access.
- Includes instructions for finding relevant Spaces and models via HuggingFace APIs and tools.
- Provides authentication setup and common usage examples for various AI generation tasks.
